verdict.rationale: Bugbot supports some natural-language interaction: users can describe in natural language when it should use low/default/high effort, and it can be triggered/configured via PR comments like `bugbot run verbose=true`. However, this is far from general natural-language command operation of the whole product — most controls (triggering reviews, BUGBOT.md config, integrations) are comment-command or config-file based, not conversational. missing for 10: evidence of broad natural-language command coverage across all Bugbot functions (not just effort level), independent confirmation of NL-driven configuration working reliably, and any chat-style interface for controlling Bugbot.
